description.value: Port O'Pierre is a pet-friendly, rustic cottage in Port Renfrew managed by Handsome Dan Enterprises, sleeping up to 4 guests in a queen bedroom and pull-out sofa, with a gas fireplace, fully equipped kitchen, outdoor BBQ, and wood-burning fire pit. It sits at the edge of the wild southern tip of Vancouver Island, a 10-minute walk from the Pacific Gateway Marina and surrounded by world-class hiking, kayaking, and storm-watching at Botanical Beach and Avatar Grove. An optional adjacent Bunkhouse can extend capacity to 7 guests, making it a practical base for groups or families on multi-day tours.

address.value: 6574 Baird Rd #1, Port Renfrew, BC V0S 1K0
